original.target_description: Study 4a; mean agreement with 104 gender-comparison statements; framing main effect in repeated-measures ANOVA with participant gender.

n.quote: Participants in Study 4a were 320 Dutch-speaking Belgian students
n.exclusions: No exclusions reported for Study 4a; reported F(1, 318) is consistent with the sample and two gender groups.

replication.target_description: Study 2; environmental comparative statements (conceptual extension of original gender statements); main effect of more-versus-less framing on mean agreement.

n.sample_role: reported final analysed sample is 434 participants; target ANOVA-specific sample cannot be established unambiguously
n.exclusions: Potential duplicate respondents excluded; Table 1 reports 442 completed, 434 final. Table 4 denominator df=431 is inconsistent with 434 participants in the stated two-group mixed ANOVA; no additional exclusion is explained in the text.
